eyebrow: Data Analyst Capstone · Advanced · Chapter 2, Lesson 7
subtitle: Marketing wants to know why orders happen

code:
SELECT SalesOrderID, COUNT(*) AS ReasonCount
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeaderSalesReason
GROUP BY SalesOrderID
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
caption: Real orders have more than one reason — a single FK column can't hold that.

eyebrow: The real fix: a bridge table
caption: Joins to the fact table through SalesOrderID — no new column on the fact itself.

subtitle: Catching warehouse problems before any front-end sees them
